name: Your Company
tagline: Gates, fence, wicket and carport for your house in one order
niche: Complete metalwork packages for private houses

listing.description: A website for a gates, fencing and carport company: ready packages with a plan and price, live job progress in percentages, and measuring bookings.

seo.title: Your Company — gates, fencing and carports in Tashkent
seo.description: Ready packages for a house: an entrance gate with wicket, a profiled-sheet or louvred fence, a carport. Design in 2 days, fitted within a week, 3-year guarantee, instalments available.
seo.answer: Your Company builds gates, fences, wickets and carports for houses in and around Tashkent as ready packages: “Entrance” (gate and wicket) from 18,000,000 UZS, “Perimeter” (gate plus 30 m of fence) from 42,000,000 UZS, and “Turnkey yard” with a carport from 68,000,000 UZS. Design in 2 days, installation in about a week, 3-year guarantee, up to 6 months’ instalments. Phone +998 71 200-07-05.

sections.title: Gate, fence and carport in one order
sections.eyebrow: Metalwork for houses · Tashkent and region
sections.subtitle: No need to find three contractors. We design the whole yard: an automated entrance gate, a wicket, a matching fence and a carport.

sections.label: About us
sections.title: A yard where everything matches
sections.text: Your Company has its own workshop in Kibray and four installation crews. Gate, fence, wicket and carport are made from one profile in one colour, so the yard looks of a piece. We lay foundations, posts and automation ourselves, with no subcontractors.

items.title: Package 1 · Entrance
items.text: Swing or sliding gate with a locking wicket, posts set in concrete.

items.title: Package 2 · Perimeter
items.text: Profiled-sheet or louvred fence on a strip foundation.

items.title: Package 3 · Turnkey yard
items.text: Everything in Package 2 plus a polycarbonate or metal-tile carport.

items.title: Package 4 · Automation
items.text: A motor for existing gates, opened by phone or remote.

sections.label: Live job
sections.title: Building now: a house in Kibray

items.title: Measuring and design — 100%
items.text: Approved a 5 m sliding gate and a graphite louvred fence.

items.title: Foundation and posts — 100%
items.text: 42 m of strip foundation poured and cured.

items.title: Workshop fabrication — 80%
items.text: Fence panels done, the gate is being painted.

items.title: Automation — 0%
items.text: The motor goes in after the gate is hung — planned for Friday.

items.title: Video intercom
items.text: A call panel on the wicket and a screen indoors.

items.title: Post lighting
items.text: A light on every post, switched by sensor.

items.q: Can I order just a gate?
items.a: Yes — the “Entrance” package is a gate with a wicket, and the rest can be added later in the same style.
30% on order, the rest in equal parts over up to 6 months at no extra cost.

items.q: Do you work outside the city?
items.a: Yes, across Tashkent Region; measuring is free within 40 km.
Three years on structure, welds and paint; one year on automation.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Send a photo of your plot — we will price a package
sections.text: 3 Ahmad Yassavi St, Kibray. Mon–Sat 9:00–18:00. Profile and colour samples are in the showroom at the workshop.
